# Fyniq API

> Fyniq's public REST API (/v1) for the accounting, compliance and reporting of a Singapore company. The web app uses only this API. AI agents and MCP clients read through it and may only propose changes, which a named person approves in the web app; they never approve, pay, file or administer anything.

Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable code and a fix. Writes take an Idempotency-Key and Prefer: return=preview; versioned records need If-Match; lists are cursor-paginated; money is a decimal string with its currency, never a JSON number.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/docs/api/agent-guide.md): how to read, how to propose, and what is never allowed
- [API reference](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/docs/api/reference.md): every operation with its permission, parameters, bodies and error codes
- [OpenAPI contract](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/contracts/openapi/fyniq.v1.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1, exactly as the API serves it at /v1/openapi.json
- [JSON Schemas](https://github.com/cognizhi/fyniq/blob/main/contracts/schemas/): one per resource (JSON Schema 2020-12)

## Operations

- `GET /v1/accounts` (listAccounts): List the chart of accounts
- `POST /v1/accounts` (createAccount): Add an account
- `GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}` (getAccount): Get an account
- `PATCH /v1/accounts/{account_id}` (updateAccount): Change an account
- `POST /v1/accounts:load-standard-chart` (loadStandardChart): Load the standard chart of accounts
- `GET /v1/approval-policies` (listApprovalPolicies): List the approval policies
- `GET /v1/approval-policies/{object_type}` (getApprovalPolicy): Get an approval policy
- `PATCH /v1/approval-policies/{object_type}` (changeApprovalPolicy): Ask to change an approval policy
- `GET /v1/approvals` (listApprovals): List the approval requests
- `GET /v1/approvals/{approval_id}` (getApproval): Get an approval request
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/approve` (approveApproval): Approve a request
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/challenge` (challengeApproval): Start signing a request with a passkey
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/reject` (rejectApproval): Reject a request
- `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/withdraw` (withdrawApproval): Withdraw your request
- `GET /v1/contacts` (listContacts): List the contacts
- `POST /v1/contacts` (createContact): Add a contact
- `GET /v1/contacts/{contact_id}` (getContact): Get a contact
- `PATCH /v1/contacts/{contact_id}` (updateContact): Change a contact
- `GET /v1/items` (listItems): List the items
- `POST /v1/items` (createItem): Add an item
- `GET /v1/items/{item_id}` (getItem): Get an item
- `PATCH /v1/items/{item_id}` (updateItem): Change an item
- `GET /v1/journals` (listJournals): List the journals
- `POST /v1/journals` (createJournal): Save a draft journal
- `GET /v1/journals/waiting-reversals` (listWaitingReversals): List the automatic reversals that wait
- `GET /v1/journals/{journal_id}` (getJournal): Get a journal
- `PUT /v1/journals/{journal_id}` (replaceJournal): Change a draft journal
- `POST /v1/journals/{journal_id}/edit` (editJournal): Edit a posted journal
- `POST /v1/journals/{journal_id}/edit-approval` (requestJournalEdit): Ask for approval to edit a posted journal
- `GET /v1/journals/{journal_id}/evidence` (listJournalEvidence): List a journal's evidence
- `POST /v1/journals/{journal_id}/evidence` (addJournalEvidence): Attach evidence to a journal
- `GET /v1/journals/{journal_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (getJournalEvidence): Get a journal's evidence file
- `DELETE /v1/journals/{journal_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}` (removeJournalEvidence): Remove evidence from a draft journal
- `POST /v1/journals/{journal_id}/post` (postJournal): Post a draft journal
- `POST /v1/journals/{journal_id}/post-approval` (requestJournalPost): Ask for approval to post a journal
- `POST /v1/journals/{journal_id}/reverse` (reverseJournal): Reverse a posted journal
- `POST /v1/journals/{journal_id}/reverse-approval` (requestJournalReversal): Ask for approval to reverse a journal
- `POST /v1/journals:bulk` (bulkCreateJournals): Save up to 250 draft journals
- `GET /v1/members` (listMembers): List the members
- `POST /v1/members` (acceptMemberInvitation): Join an organisation with an invitation
- `GET /v1/members/invitations` (listMemberInvitations): List the pending invitations
- `POST /v1/members/invitations` (createMemberInvitation): Invite someone to the organisation
- `DELETE /v1/members/invitations/{invitation_id}` (withdrawMemberInvitation): Withdraw an invitation
- `POST /v1/members/{member_id}/roles` (assignRole): Give a member a role
- `DELETE /v1/members/{member_id}/roles/{role}` (revokeRole): End a member's role
- `GET /v1/opening-balances` (getOpeningBalances): Get the opening balances
- `PUT /v1/opening-balances` (replaceOpeningBalances): Save the opening balances as a draft
- `POST /v1/opening-balances/post` (postOpeningBalances): Post the opening balances
- `GET /v1/organisation` (getOrganisation): Get your organisation
- `GET /v1/organisation/accounting` (getAccounting): Get a year's accounting framework and policies
- `POST /v1/organisation/accounting/framework` (recordAccountingFramework): Record the accounting framework
- `POST /v1/organisation/accounting/framework/{version}/confirm` (confirmAccountingFramework): Confirm the accounting framework
- `POST /v1/organisation/accounting/policies/{area}` (recordAccountingPolicy): Record an accounting policy
- `POST /v1/organisation/accounting/policies/{area}/{version}/approve` (approveAccountingPolicy): Approve an accounting policy
- `GET /v1/organisation/email/messages/{message_id}` (getEmailMessage): Get an email message's outcome
- `POST /v1/organisation/email/test-messages` (sendTestEmail): Send a test email
- `GET /v1/organisation/gst-registrations` (listGSTRegistrations): List the GST registrations
- `POST /v1/organisation/gst-registrations` (createGSTRegistration): Record a GST registration
- `GET /v1/organisation/gst-registrations/{registration_id}` (getGSTRegistration): Get a GST registration
- `PATCH /v1/organisation/gst-registrations/{registration_id}` (updateGSTRegistration): Change a GST registration
- `GET /v1/organisation/gst-status` (getGSTStatus): Get the GST status on a date
- `GET /v1/organisation/profile` (getOrganisationProfile): Get the organisation's profile
- `PATCH /v1/organisation/profile` (updateOrganisationProfile): Change the organisation's profile
- `GET /v1/organisation/sequences` (listSequences): List the document number sequences
- `GET /v1/organisation/sequences/{document_type}` (getSequence): Get a document number sequence
- `PATCH /v1/organisation/sequences/{document_type}` (updateSequence): Change a document number sequence
- `GET /v1/organisation/settings` (listSettings): List the organisation settings
- `GET /v1/organisation/settings/{key}` (getSetting): Get an organisation setting
- `PATCH /v1/organisation/settings/{key}` (updateSetting): Change an organisation setting
- `GET /v1/periods` (listPeriods): List the periods
- `GET /v1/periods/{period_id}` (getPeriod): Get a period
- `GET /v1/periods/{period_id}/close` (getPeriodClose): Get a period's close
- `POST /v1/periods/{period_id}/close` (closePeriod): Attest and close a period
- `POST /v1/periods/{period_id}/close-checks` (runCloseChecks): Run a period's close checks
- `POST /v1/periods/{period_id}/reopen` (requestPeriodReopen): Ask to reopen a closed period
- `GET /v1/periods/{period_id}/variances` (listPeriodVariances): List a period's variances
- `POST /v1/periods/{period_id}/variances/{account_id}/explanation` (explainVariance): Explain a variance
- `POST /v1/periods:open-year` (openFinancialYear): Open the next financial year
- `GET /v1/recurring-journals` (listRecurringJournals): List the recurring journals
- `POST /v1/recurring-journals` (createRecurringJournal): Add a recurring journal
- `GET /v1/recurring-journals/{recurring_journal_id}` (getRecurringJournal): Get a recurring journal
- `PUT /v1/recurring-journals/{recurring_journal_id}` (replaceRecurringJournal): Change a recurring journal
- `POST /v1/recurring-journals/{recurring_journal_id}/pause` (pauseRecurringJournal): Pause a recurring journal
- `POST /v1/recurring-journals/{recurring_journal_id}/resume` (resumeRecurringJournal): Resume a recurring journal
- `GET /v1/reports/general-ledger` (getGeneralLedger): Get the general ledger report
- `GET /v1/review-log` (listReviewLog): List the review log
- `POST /v1/review-log/reviews` (reviewLogEntries): Review high-risk actions
- `GET /v1/session` (getSession): Get your session
- `GET /v1/session/devices` (listDevices): List your devices
- `POST /v1/session/devices/sign-out-others` (signOutOtherDevices): Sign out everywhere else
- `DELETE /v1/session/devices/{device_id}` (signOutDevice): Sign a device out
- `GET /v1/session/passkeys` (listPasskeys): List your passkeys
- `POST /v1/session/passkeys` (registerPasskey): Register a passkey
- `POST /v1/session/passkeys/challenge` (startPasskeyRegistration): Start registering a passkey
- `DELETE /v1/session/passkeys/{passkey_id}` (revokePasskey): Revoke a passkey
- `POST /v1/session/step-up` (stepUp): Confirm it's you with a passkey
- `POST /v1/session/step-up/challenge` (startStepUp): Start confirming it's you with a passkey
- `GET /v1/setup` (getSetupStatus): Get the setup status
- `POST /v1/setup` (completeSetup): Complete first-run setup
- `GET /v1/sign-in-providers` (listSignInProviders): List the sign-in providers
- `GET /v1/statutory-packs` (listStatutoryPacks): List the statutory pack versions
- `GET /v1/statutory-packs/{version_id}` (getStatutoryPack): Get a statutory pack version
- `POST /v1/statutory-packs/{version_id}/activate` (activateStatutoryPack): Ask to activate a statutory pack version
- `POST /v1/super-admins` (acceptSuperAdminInvitation): Become a Super admin with an invitation
- `POST /v1/super-admins/invitations` (createSuperAdminInvitation): Invite the second Super admin
- `POST /v1/super-admins/recovery` (recoverSuperAdmin): Recover your Super admin access
- `POST /v1/super-admins/recovery-codes` (replaceSuperAdminRecoveryCodes): Replace your recovery codes
- `POST /v1/super-admins/{user_id}/recovery-confirmations` (confirmSuperAdminRecovery): Confirm the other Super admin's recovery
- `GET /v1/team-mode` (getTeamMode): Get the team mode
- `PATCH /v1/team-mode` (switchTeamMode): Ask to switch the team mode
